title: Formal Code Verification & Property-Based Testing (PYTH_186_S1 to PYTH_186_S8)

slides.title: Property-Based Testing with Hypothesis
slides.prompt: Property-based testing generates randomized input cases to assert general software invariants rather than testing static hand-coded example cases.

slides.title: Hypothesis Input Decorator
slides.prompt: Fill in the Hypothesis decorator used to feed generated strategy inputs into a test function.

slides.title: Hypothesis Shrinking Mechanism
slides.prompt: What action does Hypothesis perform when it discovers a randomized input combination that fails an assertion?
options: It performs 'shrinking' to find the minimal, simplest reproduction test case that causes the failure
It immediately discards the test run and retries silently
It mutates the source code to auto-fix the error
It logs the full system RAM dump to disk
slides.correctAnswer: It performs 'shrinking' to find the minimal, simplest reproduction test case that causes the failure

slides.title: Hypothesis Strategies Module
slides.prompt: Fill in the module alias commonly imported to declare data type generation rules.

slides.title: Design by Contract (Contracts)
slides.prompt: Which contractual assertions define conditions that must hold true BEFORE and AFTER function execution?

slides.title: Stateful Testing with Hypothesis
slides.prompt: Fill in the Hypothesis rule-based class used to verify state machine invariant flows.

slides.title: Formal Z3 SMT Solver Integration
slides.prompt: What is the primary function of the Z3 SMT Solver library in Python formal verification?
options: Proving or disproving logical mathematical assertions over algebraic software constraints
Running concurrent unit tests across multiple CPU sockets
slides.correctAnswer: Proving or disproving logical mathematical assertions over algebraic software constraints

slides.title: Assume Condition Filtering
slides.prompt: Fill in the Hypothesis function used to discard invalid input choices during randomized strategy generation.
